en: This part is titled "Skul". "Have you heard of the tomb of that foreign little boy?".

No explanation here, just a large picture of a knight clad in blue plates with horns and a title: "Shovel Knight".
His shovel is especially visible.
Looks like the reproduction of a painting...
On this "Hotline Miami" page, I can read:  "Knock knock" "Who's th-" BONK BONK BONK SPLAT!
A report titled "Katana Zero" : "They said that the Dragon, or "Fifteen" as he was called in his unit was able to slash through his enemies with his katana without getting hit."

It says here, under the title "Risk of Rain", that the surface of Petrichor V is dotted with strange shrines. 
Adventurers prayed them in the hope of getting loot from them.
Good idea, I'll try that if I find one!
"Attention, Terraria adventurers: you must sacrifice the Guide Voodoo Doll in the magma to summon the Wall of Flesh".
No way, I won't throw one of my precious items in the lava!

A drawing, titled "Slay the Spire", represents a three-pronged symbol, each with a small sketch. 
A bag of coins is drawn on the red prong. 
On the blue one, a sword is linked to a key via a short chain. 
Lastly, the green prong is topped with a red-eyed skull.
I really don't get contemporary art, I just don't have the keys to understand it!
And the rats haven't even got to him yet.
...I bet there's still some good stuff to scavenge!
Meh, just some rusty old key...
"Royal Gardener, with all the respect that I owe you... OBEY YOUR ORDERS or you will find yourself in the stomach of one of the ticks!"
"For all our sakes, this is your last warning."
Ergh, nothing of interest at all...
Congratulations! You've reached the end of this demo!
The drain seems to be clogged... There must be another way out.
"If you're reading this, it means that I'm dead."
"You need to investigate the report about the Giant's corpse disappearing from the Prison."
"The King entrusted him with something that mustn't fall into the wrong hands."
Hmph... can't even find something worth cooking around here...
You may as well take it. Wish you luck! ...You will need it.
Grilled tentacle? You, sir, are a man of great taste.
Are you gonna buy something or what?
You know, this is starting to get on my nerves...
Just my luck to get stuck with the island idiot.
I've got nothing to offer you, scram!
There's something fishy about this beast...
Mirror, mirror, on the wall, where's the next blueprint? Nothing...

Tired of killing the same monsters over and over?
Bored by the landscapes of this small island?
I think we can help each other.
Meet me in the sewers, where I’m restocking for food.
Whatever was on this altar disappeared ::t:: ago...
Chat managed to break the chest open!
Mumble... the end is near... grumble...
Have you heard about our inevitable end?
I've been telling everyone for a long time, it's bound to happen someday!
Judging from the look he is giving me, he wants me to keep going...
You're so nice to me! I'll follow you until the end!
I hope you've got some food for me.
*yawn* ... What did you wake me up for?
Who are we fighting!? Ah... Who cares!
